[{"insert":"Pronated Pull Up + Supinated Pull Up 

Same drop set structure as the earlier weeks, but reps drop to 6, so the weight goes up. The pronated pull up comes first, then you move to the supinated grip with your palms facing you, which brings the biceps in to help the lats so you can squeeze out a few more reps once the pronated pull is fatigued. Start with your Week 3 weights and add from there.
"}]
